result.title: When Visually Rich Documents Meet Multi-Vector Retrieval for Region-level Retrieval-Augmented Generation
result.summary: Visually rich documents (VRDs) convey knowledge through textual, visual, and layout information that text-centric Retrieval-Augmented Generation (Text-RAG) struggles to fully exploit. Recent Vision-RAG approaches enable retrieval and generation directly from document images, retaining this multimodal information. However, earlier Vision-RAG methods commonly adopt coarse retrieval representations and full-page visual contexts, which can obscure local evidence and introduce substantial redundancy and computational overhead. To address these challenges, we propose MV-VisRAG, a region-level Vision-RAG framework that uses semantically complete regions for both document representation and visual augmentation. Specifically, MV-VisRAG first constructs these regions through a ContentAdaptive Regionalization module. It then encodes them into local region vectors and a page-level global vector using a VLM-based retriever trained through multimodal reconstruction pretraining and retrieval fine-tuning. With this compact multi-vector representation, MV-VisRAG performs late-interaction retrieval and estimates region contributions from the resulting matching scores. These contributions guide the selection of relevant regions, which are then rearranged into a compact visual context for generation. Experiments across five benchmarks demonstrate retrieval and generation gains over corresponding baselines, while region-level augmentation substantially reduces visual tokens and computational cost. Our code will be made publicly available at https://github.com/xandery-geek/MV-VisRAG.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 MV-VisRAG：先把视觉丰富文档切成语义完整的区域，用基于 VLM 的检索器编码成区域向量与页级全局向量，经 late-interaction 检索并按匹配分数估计区域贡献，选取相关区域压缩为视觉上下文供生成，并在五个基准上评测。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「区域级证据筛选 + 由匹配分数估计贡献」与 LVR 关注的视觉证据筛选、视觉 token 成本控制直接相关，可供核查；但检索相关性分数是否等于生成实际依赖的证据，仍需读原文验证。
